title: Dawn Patrol | KEY.co
description_expanded: Steps from the pristine shores of Grayton Beach, this stunning six-bedroom, four-bathroom retreat promises the ultimate blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm. With over 3,400 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space across four levels, this home accommodates up to 19 guests—perfect for large families or groups. The private heated pool, complete with a swim-up bar, outdoor TV, and grilling station, invites you to bask in Florida sunshine, while three spacious decks deliver breathtaking Gulf views for serene mornings and unforgettable sunsets. A six-person golf cart and seven adult bikes make exploring the vibrant local scene a breeze, while the in-home elevator ensures effortless access to every floor. Inside, the home’s interiors combine style and functionality, featuring a chef’s kitchen, expansive dining space, and multiple living areas. The second-floor kitchen boasts high-end appliances and granite countertops, with an adjacent dining area seating 12. Upstairs, the third-floor bunk nook and additional living room create the perfect family-friendly retreat. The crown jewel awaits on the fourth floor, where the primary suite offers a private sanctuary with an en-suite bathroom and a secluded balcony showcasing panoramic ocean views. Just moments from Grayton Beach’s renowned dining, shopping, and natural trails, this property is your gateway to relaxation and adventure on 30A.
